subject: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — next steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmecorp.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — next steps & scheduling

Hi Raj / Alicia,

Thanks again for your time earlier — really helpful to understand Acme's priorities around latency and multi-tenant isolation for the new chat assistant. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: main constraints are 99th percentile latency under 200ms for interactive queries, data isolation for regulated tenant flows, and a break/fix SLA for inference timeouts.
- Proposed next step: one exec alignment intro (VP/CTO) to agree on scope, sign-off criteria, and timeline; followed by a technical deep dive/demo for the infra team.

I've attached a short proposed agenda for the exec alignment call and a demo outline that we can tailor. Could you share 2-3 30-45 minute slots over next week that work for the VP/CTO (or the right exec)? If easier, here's a quick sched link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?ref=acme

Agenda (draft, attached):
- 10m: goals & success metrics (Acme execs)
- 15m: how Redwood maps to latency/cost targets (high level)
- 10m: rollout & security/compliance gating (SOC2/KMS, data flow)
- 5m: next steps / decision timeline

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — next steps & scheduling

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the agenda. Alicia and I reviewed and this looks aligned with what we need.

A couple items:
- Please include Sanjay Mehta (CTO) on the exec intro — he owns platform architecture and will need to sign off on the isolation approach.
- Would also like a short pre-demo sync (technical) with our infra lead (Sanjay or I will invite) so your engineering team can see our current infra constraints.

Sanjay's availability: 2029-08-06 10:30-11:30 PT OR 2029-08-07 14:00-15:00 PT. If neither work, Raj: feel free to send a few other options.

If you can confirm one of those slots, Alicia will create the calendar invite.

—Raj
VP, Engineering
AcmeCorp
raj.patel@acmecorp.com

Thanks Raj — looping in Rishi (solutions engineer) and Jonas (sales engineer) to run the technical deep dive/demo and to join the exec alignment call where relevant.

Rishi/Jonas — Raj proposed Sanjay's availability: 2029-08-06 10:30-11:30 PT OR 2029-08-07 14:00-15:00 PT. Which slot would work best for your schedules? We should plan to run a 30-45 min exec alignment (Marissa + Raj + Sanjay + Alicia) and then schedule a separate 60-90 min technical deep dive with Acme infra — Rishi/Jonas can run that.

For the exec alignment, suggested outcomes:
- Confirm success metrics (latency, availability, cost target)
- Agree on gating criteria for pilot vs. GA rollout
- Alignment on timeline and who signs off from Acme

If it's helpful, here are two quick options to lock the exec call:
- Option A: 2029-08-06 10:30 PT (30-40m)
- Option B: 2029-08-07 14:00 PT (30-40m)

Calendly link again: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?ref=acme

I've re-attached the one-pager agenda.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (re-sent)

Thanks — Rishi/Jonas, could you confirm your preference by EOD PT?

Best,
Marissa

Option A (2029-08-06 10:30 PT) works for Sanjay and me. Alicia will send the calendar invite once you confirm the slot.

For the technical deep dive, Sanjay asked that your engineering lead include a short section on prefix/KV caching and routing fallback strategies — those are the two things we want to validate before the pilot. Can Rishi or Jonas add 10-15 minutes to the technical deep dive agenda to cover this?

Also, please send any pre-read or architecture notes you want the infra team to review ahead of the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to the alignment call.

—Raj
